description: Poly merge for the MixMaster inserts and CV inputs: the poly input is normalled to the poly output, and each mono input replaces its channel there or adds to it when that channel is unused

params.text: Green passes that track's pair of mono inputs to the poly output, red drops them so that the poly input's own two channels pass instead

inputs.text: The sixteen-channel signal normalled to the poly output
Replaces the left channel of that track in the poly output, or adds to it when that poly channel carries nothing
Replaces the right channel of that track in the poly output, or adds to it when that poly channel carries nothing

outputs.text: Carries the poly input with the patched mono inputs merged into their channels

notes: the panel choice only relabels the jacks; it changes nothing about what the module does with them.
menu: Audio panels — relabels the jacks for tracks 1-8, tracks 9-16 or the group and aux busses
CV panels — relabels the jacks for the MixMaster and AuxSpander poly CV inputs: mute, solo, group and master mute and solo, the four aux sends, the send mutes and the aux bus jacks
CV panels Jr — relabels the jacks for the MixMasterJr and AuxSpanderJr poly CV inputs
